finding.title: Structured model cancellation loses the runtime stop reason
code_chain: runtime.py:1152-1171 computes cancelled.reason, including agent_time_limit for cumulative active round time >= max_seconds and agent_time_budget_exhausted for lifetime.
runtime.py:325-326 passes remaining round/lifetime monotonic deadline.
bridge.py:149-153 requests transport cancellation when callback true or deadline expired.
bridge.py:206-209 throws AgentModelResponseError(agent_cancelled) whenever callback true, ignoring cancelled.reason; HTTPException/AdapterError branches have the same collapse.
runtime.py:362-370 records that collapsed code before rethrow; run_once AgentError branch1187-1190 forwards unchanged, unlike ValueError1203-1204 and tool1183-1184.
runtime.py:1016-1034 finishes verification unverified with supplied error.

minimal_reproduction.method: In-memory AgentModelBridge with synthetic peer execute_order; callback initially false, synthetic order sets stop=true and returns cancelled/consumer_cancelled; callback.reason=agent_time_limit. No filesystem mutation or API.

timelines.label: A task (also executing on consumer host, not provider-host Agent)

interpretation.confirmed: Both orders were actively cancelled before final return; authenticated provider terminal states and returned error_code are consumer_cancelled. No task-level owner cancel event occurs in these target task histories. Both tasks have round max_seconds180, lifetime3600; no lifetime exhaustion. Final durations are not timestamps of initial cancellation.
interpretation.round_budget_cause: Strongly supported by code and timing: after subtracting post-cancel waiting, final active round charges are near180. A had already used approximately137 seconds in that round including an earlier checker and repair; B approximately24. Exact pre-request ledger records and callback.reason were not exported, so this is a code+timing attribution rather than directly logged callback value.
interpretation.not_proven: No upstream exception audit exists: RestrictedAdapter logs dispatch/response/cancel but not rejected exception (node.py122-135). Cannot distinguish vendor timeout, late successful response discarded after cancel, or network error. Do not claim GLM timed out merely from approximately180-second final interval.
interpretation.delayed_stop: bridge awaits execute_order synchronously after best-effort cancellation. routes3493-3531 marks and signs cancel; provider routes822-826 calls adapter cancel; adapters557-565 records flag and closes response only if already available. Blocking urlopen before headers has no registered response; cancellation cannot guarantee immediate remote/provider computation stop. Provider routes643-653 maps prior cancelled state to consumer_cancelled, obscuring original later exception by design.
interpretation.streaming: Checker has no tools; bridge.py92 enables streaming only when on_event AND tool_specs AND target streaming. These calls were non-streaming and transport evidence has stream_events0. Absence of reasoning chunks is not proof of no upstream computation.
interpretation.budget: Unknown usage remains conservative reservation (both final tasks usage_complete=false); final active time includes wait beyond stop request. No late response/tool execution success was published.

recommended_fix_boundary: Preserve a closed trusted callback reason for structured bridge rejection and meter event, including actual round/lifetime exhaustion and owner/security revocations. Do not turn unknown arbitrary callback strings into public error text. User cancel must remain agent_cancelled.

Test actual runtime round/lifetime expiry through bridge and budget ledger: terminal cause correct, unknown usage conservative, late response/tool not published; also explicit owner cancel and malicious reason.
Do not change round180/lifetime3600/source180/retry policy in this fix. Future tuning requires separately chosen workload budget, not bypassing the gate.

Separate future transport improvement: interruptible cancellation/deadline propagation and safe original exception metadata, with ownership/reconciliation and late-use tests. No claim that this fix stops remote compute sooner.
